newsitem.title: FINLAND: Sponda behind big UPM, Enso deal.
newsitem.headline: Sponda behind big UPM, Enso deal.

text.p: Finnish state-controlled asset management company Sponda Oy said on Wednesday big deals in forest industry companies UPM-Kymmene Oy and Enso Oy were in-house transfers from its units to the parent.
"Sponda's 100-percent-owned subsidiaries sold their UPM and Enso shares to Sponda Oy," managing director Kari Kolu told Reuters by telephone.
He said the deals comprised 8.4 million UPM-Kymmene shares and 12.6 million series R shares in Enso Oy.
These amounts correspond to big blocks of shares in the two forest companies traded in-house on the Helsinki bourse on Wednesday by the brokerage of state-owned bank Postipankki.
Kolu said the ultimate task of Sponda was to sell assets which had fallen into the lap of the state when it stepped in to prevent a banking sector crash in the early 1990s.
The Sponda units which on Wednesday sold their forest shares to the parent company were Immutata Oy, Arpera Oy, SP-Sijoitus Oy and Oy Skofaks Ab. @
